name: @pipeworx/mcp-law-feeds

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: List the curated law & courts feeds (id, title, category, source). Optionally filter by category (government, law) or keyword. Pass an id to read_feed.

query.description: Keyword to match in feed title/source/description.

tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: Read a curated law & courts feed by its id (from list_feeds). Returns normalized items (title, link, published, summary). Optionally filter items by keyword.

tools.name: fetch_feed
tools.description: Fetch and normalize any RSS / Atom / RDF feed by URL. CF-robust: fetches directly and falls back to a proxy if the source blocks the gateway. Use list_feeds first for curated sources.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-law-feeds forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the law-feeds pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
